overview: The Medford City Council approved a resolution establishing a citizen street recovery program backed by a request for $1 million from free cash to repair winter-damaged roads. Councilors also requested internal budget transfer reports and asked the police chief to review the city's resident permit parking system.

items.title: Citizen Street Recovery Program Resolution
items.summary: Approved a resolution establishing a citizen street recovery program to track and fix potholes, amended to request $1 million from certified free cash and a cost estimate from the city engineer to resurface emergency arteries.

items.title: Condolences for Herbert Clark
items.summary: Approved a resolution extending condolences to the family of World War II veteran Herbert Clark and voted to adjourn the meeting in his honor.

items.title: Report on Internal Budget Transfers and Revenue Collections
items.summary: Approved a request for the administration to supply a breakdown of all internal department budget transfers made through February, along with a revenue collection report from the Assessor's Office.

items.title: Announcement of Committee Meeting on Opiate Addiction
items.summary: Announced a Committee of the Whole meeting scheduled for March 18 to address opiate addiction in the city.

items.title: Resident Permit Parking Program Enforcement and Sector Parking
items.summary: Approved a motion requesting the police chief report on revamping the permit parking program and implementing sector-based parking, alongside requests to temporarily ease enforcement on overcrowded streets.

items.title: Community Announcements
items.summary: Received announcements for a fundraiser supporting the Krystle Campbell Memorial Peace Garden and a 5K race benefiting Children's Hospital.

items.title: Public Input on People's Forum and City Communication
items.summary: Heard public petition comments advocating for weekly civic discussion topics and broader broadcast notifications, leading to a request for Comcast to explain its EveryBlock platform to the council.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting records of March 3, 2015, while keeping the records from February 17 and February 24 on the table.
